t: You're looking at St Peter's, a Church of England church on Kennington Lane in Vauxhall. It was designed by John Loughborough Pearson, a leading Gothic Revival architect known for his churches and cathedrals. Pearson revived the art of vaulting, the ribbed stone roofing of medieval builders, and was said to be unrivalled at it in his generation. He worked on at least two hundred and ten ecclesiastical buildings in England across fifty-four years, and this is one of them.
